epics.title: Knowledge Base Core Cataloging
epics.jtbd: When managing epidemiological materials, I want to catalog, edit, and publish documents, so that the latest protocols are centrally available.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to publish a new protocol to under 4 hours.
requirements: R1: Editor can catalog a new epidemiological material or protocol.
R2: Editor can update and publish materials.
R3: Editor can unpublish stale content.
R4: System provides a way to recover a locked-out account.
R5: System provides a self-service password reset path.

slices.title: Catalog data schema
slices.jtbd: When implementing the catalog for this epic, I want to define the schema for materials and protocols, so that documents are structured and preserved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an editor creates a material, When saved, Then the database stores it properly.
Given an editor updates a material, When saved, Then the update is persisted safely.

slices.title: Catalog API contract
slices.jtbd: When implementing the API contract for this epic, I want to define endpoints for cataloging, so that frontend and backend build simultaneously.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a need to catalog, When reading the spec, Then POST /api/materials is documented.
Given a need to publish, When reading the spec, Then PUT /api/materials/{id} is documented.

slices.title: Catalog backend logic
slices.jtbd: When building backend logic for this epic, I want to build the endpoints for cataloging, so that the knowledge base persists accurately.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a valid payload, When POSTed, Then the backend saves and returns 201.
Given an unpublish request, When processed, Then the item status is updated safely.

slices.title: Catalog editing UI
slices.jtbd: When implementing UI for this epic, I want to build forms to catalog materials, so that editors can manage knowledge easily.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an editor types a protocol, When a network error occurs, Then what the user typed survives.
Given the editor views on mobile, When editing, Then the UI is fully responsive.
Given an editor clicks unpublish, When clicked, Then the destructive action asks for confirmation.
Given the user navigates by keyboard, When tabbing, Then all inputs meet WCAG AA visible focus.

slices.title: Cataloging flow QA
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to test the full lifecycle, so that no broken forms reach production.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the API, When integration tested, Then database persistence is accurate.
Given the UI, When E2E tested, Then an editor can successfully catalog, edit, and unpublish a material.
Given business logic, When unit tested, Then all validation rules apply.

slices.title: Editor account recovery API
slices.jtbd: When building auth logic for this epic, I want to provide a password reset flow, so that editors can recover accounts independently.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a reset request, When the email is valid, Then a secure short-lived token is generated.
Given a valid token and new password, When submitted, Then the password updates safely.

slices.title: Editor account recovery UI
slices.jtbd: When building auth UI for this epic, I want to provide forms for password reset, so that locked-out users can return.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user on login, When they click reset, Then they see an email form.
Given a user clicks the reset link, When it loads, Then they can securely type a new password.
Given navigation, When tabbing, Then focus is visible per WCAG AA.

epics.title: Knowledge Base Discovery
epics.jtbd: When looking for protocols, I want to search and view epidemiological materials, so that I can apply correct procedures.
requirements: R1: User can search for epidemiological protocols and data.
R2: User can view and read the full material details.
R3: If no results exist, the user gets clear feedback.

slices.title: Search API contract
slices.jtbd: When defining search for this epic, I want to outline the query endpoint, so that frontend matches backend perfectly.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the search UI, When reviewing spec, Then GET /api/search is defined.
Given material read UI, When reviewing spec, Then GET /api/materials/{id} is defined.

slices.title: Search backend logic
slices.jtbd: When building backend search for this epic, I want to process queries fast, so that users find what they need immediately.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a keyword query, When sent, Then relevant materials return.
Given a read request, When the material exists, Then details are returned.

slices.title: Search and document UI
slices.jtbd: When building discovery UI for this epic, I want to implement the search bar and document viewer, so that users can read protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user searches, When zero results return, Then they see explicit feedback and suggestions.
Given mobile usage, When reading, Then the document viewer scales correctly.
Given a keyboard user, When navigating search results, Then focus is clearly visible (WCAG AA).

slices.title: Discovery QA
slices.jtbd: When testing discovery for this epic, I want to verify search accuracy and UI robustness, so that users always retrieve the right data.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given unit tests, When run, Then queries map to database properly.
Given E2E tests, When run, Then a user can search and open a document.
Given integration tests, When run, Then API responses match.

epics.title: Knowledge Base Operational Telemetry
epics.jtbd: When operating the product, I want to measure search success and backup health, so that we know the knowledge base is reliable and useful.
requirements: R1: Measure how many searches lead to a clicked protocol to answer 'Are users finding what they need?'.
R2: A tested database restore is executed to prove backup integrity.
R3: Regular database backups are automated to secure epidemiological data.
R4: Initial content is seeded so paths are walkable.

slices.title: Telemetry metrics capture
slices.jtbd: When building telemetry for this epic, I want to record search outcomes, so that we can evaluate product success.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user search, When it concludes, Then success or failure is recorded in metrics.
Given integration tests, When checking telemetry, Then it confirms accurate payload recording.

slices.title: Backup and Restore Automation
slices.jtbd: When building infra for this epic, I want to script automated backups and a proven restore, so that the knowledge base is safe.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given scheduled backups, When run, Then data is stored safely.
Given a restore script, When executed, Then it recovers the database completely in a clean environment.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Restore works 100% of the time in tests.

slices.title: Initial Data Seeding
slices.jtbd: When preparing data for this epic, I want to seed initial Russian epidemiological materials, so that the product is immediately demonstrable.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean database, When seeded, Then it contains representative Russian protocols.
Given a test run, When verified, Then it asserts all seed documents are present.
